name: Chastisement
overview: The Scriptures reveal that chastisement is a deliberate act of God’s righteous judgment against sin, demonstrated by His fury and measured discipline, as seen in Leviticus 26:28 where God chastises Israel seven times for their sins. Deuteronomy 11 emphasizes that God’s chastisement is not only a punishment but also a testimony to His greatness, mighty hand, and miraculous power, recalling His acts against Egypt and the rebellion of Dathan and Abiram. This divine correction serves both as a warning and a means to uphold God’s holiness among His people.
